importPredictions.srgb: updates same seeded variable to components, alpha 1

acceptance.devMode: All 21 layers must have readable CSS, screenshot and two recorded readings. Test predictions only after readings are saved. Retain any mismatch.
acceptance.input: Actual stored channels must match preregistered input; otherwise label input failure rather than silently changing predictions.
acceptance.imports: Same variable name and ID in all trials; successful srgb paired control; UI error plus unchanged sentinel for skip; two cycles in each profile.
acceptance.environment: Record browser, OS, Node, Color.js and available Figma build before collecting; explicitly mark unavailable Figma web build.
acceptance.independence: Second reading must be recorded before model comparison. Same-agent rereading is not a blinded independent researcher.
